Financial Year: All annual figures are intentionally generalized for sharing and demonstration.
Total KGs Sold is set to 100 KG for each financial year.
The 8 flavour categories are equally distributed at 12.5 KG per year.
Revenue, purchase expense, profit and profit margin are illustrative and identical across years.
This workbook does not represent actual GH Chikkis production, sales, expenses or profitability.
Organic = combined KG from all historical organic-labelled flavour entries.
This is not net profit because other operating expenses are not separately available in the source ledgers.
